preferred_use: Default news draft: municipal news, weather/institutional notices, mid-length reports.

common_patterns: Direct fact statement: 'Набират доброволци за разкопките на Русокастро'.
Result/decision form: 'Черноморец взе три точки от Берое'.
Number-led service form: '21 сигнала за мазут по Черноморието...'.
No quote/colon/question marks (0% quotes in house 2020+).
avoid: Do not open headline with a quotation.
Do not use colon or question form.
Do not copy legacy headline-repeat opening (0% in house 2020+).

typical_patterns: Immediate fact expanded: P1 restates headline + adds who/when/where in the same sentence.
Institutional attribution in P1: 'съобщават от НИМХ', 'съобщиха от пресцентъра на ОД на МВР'.
Opening classes: immediate_fact ~77% in recent house (37/48); event_date_first ~12%; place_first ~6%.

body.paragraph_shape: 3-5 paragraphs; median body ~1000-1330 chars; first para longest (median ~267-455 chars), closing para short (~195-230).
body.sentence_shape: Medium sentences, median ~16-17 words; no one-line staccato.
body.pacing: Even: fact -> detail -> context -> short closing line.
structure: Last: short status/closing line, not a summary moral.

quotes.frequency: Inline quotes only; quote-mark density ~3-6 per 1000 chars (lower than culture).
quotes.placement: Quote normally in P2-P4, never as the opening line (quote_first 1/48 recent house).

tone.factual_vs_descriptive: Strongly factual; adjectives only in institutional names.
tone.local_specificity: Full formal institution + place in P1 (press-center formula).

conventions: Press-center formula verbatim: 'съобщиха от пресцентъра на Областна дирекция на МВР в Бургас'.
Full dates with ordinal: 'на 1-ви септември около 21.10 ч.'.
Number + unit spelled in body ('км. 442+700', '2-3 бала').

recurring_preferences: 'съобщиха от пресцентъра', 'е станал/станал', 'в района', 'с бургаска регистрация', 'почистване/разпореди' (service verbs).

avoidances: Never invent a blockquote or pull-quote layout.
Never add a subheadline/lead element (template has none).
Never use first person or rhetorical questions.
Never treat caption/tags as voice (they are CMS metadata).
evidence_notes: n=40 house 2020-2026, 3-5 paras; hl_repeat 0%; hl_quote 0%; immediate_fact 37/48 recent-house; quote density ~3-6/1000.

preferred_use: Shortest drafts: incident blotter, school send-off notices, single-fact service items.

headline.typical_length: Short: median ~39 chars, ~7 words; shortest of all profiles.
common_patterns: Incident result form: 'Мъж се блъсна в комбайн и загина на място'.
Number/alcohol form: 'Моторист шофирал с 2.21 промила алкохол'.
avoid: Do not expand beyond the single fact + attribution.
Do not add background paragraphs the source record lacks.

typical_patterns: Whole story in one block (median 558 chars, 1 para): headline fact + ', съобщиха от пресцентъра...' + time/place/vehicle details.
No development arc: the first sentence IS the story.

body.paragraph_shape: 1-2 paragraphs, median ~558 chars; first para median ~558 (whole story).
body.sentence_shape: Shorter sentences, median ~13 words; dense with numbers.
body.pacing: Flat: all facts at once, no build.

quotes.frequency: Few or no quotes; quote density ~7.7/1000 comes from quoted vehicle/place names, not speech.
quotes.integration: '..., съобщиха от пресцентъра на ОД на МВР в Бургас. Инцидентът е станал на ...'.

conventions: Highest number density of any profile (~16.8/1000): times, ages, registration, promille.
Ordinal date + clock in sentence 2, always.

recurring_preferences: 'съобщиха от пресцентъра', 'Инцидентът е станал/станал', 'с бургаска регистрация', 'управляван от ...-годишен', 'движещ се с несъобразена скорост'.

evidence_notes: n=15 (PROVISIONAL: below 20, but internally consistent); 11/15 are 2024-2026 practice; number density ~16.8/1000 vs ~11 house; sentence median ~13 vs ~16.7 house.

scope: category Култура, 6+ paras, any period (17 articles)
preferred_use: Long culture drafts: festival/concert/theatre reports, results roundups, multi-act programs.

headline.typical_length: Median ~55 chars, ~9 words; longest headlines of the set.
common_patterns: Event + place form: 'Епопея на забравените с премиера през септември в бургаския театър'.
Edition form: 'Деветото издание на Порт Прим Арт Фест започва на 7 октомври'.
Occasional quoted title in headline (~6%, only profile where it survives in recent data).
avoid: Do not shorten to blotter length.
Do not strip program/result detail to fit a news template.

typical_patterns: Scene/result opening (immediate_fact 11/17); quote_first allowed (1/17) - only profile where a quoted-title opening is acceptable.
Legacy headline-repeat opening appears only in pre-2020 members (3/17); do NOT imitate it in new drafts.

body.paragraph_shape: 6+ paragraphs (median 7), median body ~2100 chars; P1 ~300 chars, closing ~150-190.
body.sentence_shape: Longest sentences, median ~17.3 words; list-like cast/program sentences.
body.pacing: Episodic: result -> acts/program -> cast/names -> money/prize -> funders/closing line.
structure: P2-P4: program/cast/prizes with dense proper names.
Last: funder/support line ('Проектът е реализиран с подкрепата на ...').

quotes.frequency: Highest quote density (~8.7/1000): titles, speech, mottos.
quotes.placement: Titles in P1; speech quotes in P2-P5.
quotes.integration: Quoted work titles inline with guillemets/curly quotes; speech with 'каза/сподели'.

tone.factual_vs_descriptive: Factual base with celebratory adjectives ('зрелищно', 'вдъхновяващ', 'вкусна') - only profile where they are conventional.
tone.narrative_distance: Closest of the set, but still third person.
tone.local_specificity: Venue + town in headline or P1 (theatre/stage/town).

conventions: Prize/money lines kept ('премията от 12 000 лева', '6 000 лева получи екипът...').
Cast lists as comma chains in one paragraph.

avoidances: Never imitate pre-2020 headline-repeat opening in new drafts.
evidence_notes: n=17 (PROVISIONAL); longest body (~2100 vs ~1000-1330 house); longest sentences (~17.3); highest quote density (~8.7); celebratory adjectives conventional only here.

preferred_use: Forward-looking drafts: festival/concert/exhibition announcements, program + practical-info items.

common_patterns: Future announcement: 'Епопея на забравените с премиера през септември...'.
Program form: 'Варненско лято продължава със симпозиум, конференция и форум...'.
Edition + date: 'Деветото издание ... започва на 7 октомври'.
avoid: Do not write in past-result tense.

typical_patterns: Future-tense P1: 'ще има своята премиера на 18-ти септември на сцената...'.
Date/venue early: day + month + stage/town inside the first 2 sentences.

body.paragraph_shape: 5 paras median (vs 4 non-event); median body ~1580 chars (vs ~1120).
structure: Last: practical line (start date, venue, support/funders).

tone.factual_vs_descriptive: Factual but anticipatory; mild promotional adjectives allowed ('емблематичният', 'зрелищно').

conventions: Future tense + exact date ('ще има своята премиера на 18-ти септември').

avoidances: Never write the event as already happened.
evidence_notes: n=21 (PROVEN); 'ще' density ~2.2 vs ~0.7; longer body (~1580 vs ~1120) and longer sentences (~17.1 vs ~15.4); overlaps CULTURE_FEATURE by design (event previews are often culture) - retrieval prefers EVENT_PREVIEW when the request is forward-looking.

preferred_use: Signed reportage drafts: on-site ceremony/forum coverage with multiple voices; opt-in when the editor wants a named byline.

headline.typical_length: Longest headlines: median ~60 chars, ~9 words (vs ~52 house recent).
common_patterns: Ceremony/forum result: 'В Царево раздадоха годишните награди за туризъм'.
Institutional meeting: 'НХА и държавният ВУЗ с меморандум...'.
avoid: Do not use for anonymous blotter items.
Do not shorten quotes to one-liners.

typical_patterns: On-scene opening with place + occasion: 'В Царево раздадоха... Морската община стана домакин...'.
Second voice early: P2 already carries a named quote.

body.paragraph_shape: 5-6 paras median (5.5), median body ~1640 chars (longest of recent groups).
body.sentence_shape: Median ~15.6 words; quote paragraphs alternate with narrative.
body.pacing: Scene -> voice -> voice -> detail -> result-list closing.
structure: P2-P4: alternating named quotes (minister, mayor, organizer).
Last: result list or forward-looking line.

quotes.frequency: Quote density ~6.0/1000 with multiple distinct speakers per article (vs single-source house).
quotes.placement: Quotes from P2 onward, several speakers.
quotes.integration: Full-name + role attribution: 'каза зам.-министърът на туризма Павлин Петров', 'каза кметът ... Марин Киров'.

tone.factual_vs_descriptive: Factual with on-scene color ('Морската община стана домакин', 'в първия ден на лятото').
tone.narrative_distance: Closest to the scene; still third person.
tone.local_specificity: Place-as-host framing ('Царево става столица на туризма').

conventions: Motto lines kept ('Мотото на наградите тази година е: ...').
Role + full name on every quote.

avoidances: Never publish under a house signature (requires named byline).
Never reduce to a single source.
Do not generalize beyond 2024-2026: legacy Desislava (pre-2020) wrote differently (headline-repeat 64%, quoted headlines 24%) and is NOT part of this profile.
evidence_notes: n=12 (PROVISIONAL: below 20 but coherent and recent); longest recent body (~1640 vs ~1110 house); most tags (~7.3 vs ~4.4); multi-speaker quotes; legacy pre-2020 Desislava style is documented drift, excluded.
